source.name: Parma Calcio 1913, 'Prometeon, AdmiralBet.news, and inX.aero, our jersey!'
source.quote: Prometeon, a leader in the industrial tyre manufacturing sector, is the Main Sponsor of Parma Calcio for the third consecutive year.
source.note: Still on the 2026/27 home shirt: the club's kit-launch press release (SportParma, 2026-06-05, https://sportparma.com/parma-calcio/parma-ecco-la-maglia-crociata-per-la-stagione-2026-2027.html, opened 2026-10-03) says 'Sulla maglia della Prima Squadra Maschile saranno presenti i loghi di Prometeon, AdmiralBet.news, Crédit Agricole e Moby'.

source.name: Parma Calcio 1913, 'Prometeon, AdmiralBet.news, and inX.aero, our jersey!'
source.quote: For the first time, the brand will be the Second Sponsor on the jersey
source.note: Second sponsor on the front. Still on the 2026/27 home shirt: the club's kit-launch press release (SportParma, 2026-06-05, https://sportparma.com/parma-calcio/parma-ecco-la-maglia-crociata-per-la-stagione-2026-2027.html, opened 2026-10-03) lists the AdmiralBet.news logo among the four brand logos on the Men's First Team shirt.

source.name: Crédit Agricole Italia press release, 'Al via la partnership tra Crédit Agricole Italia e Parma Calcio'
source.quote: la Banca diventa per i prossimi tre anni Sleeve Sponsor della squadra gialloblu e il marchio CA compare sulla manica sinistra della maglia Gara della Prima Squadra Maschile
source.note: The Bank becomes sleeve sponsor for the next three years, with the CA brand on the left sleeve of the men's first-team match shirt. A three-year term from September 2024 covers 2026/27, and the club's kit-launch press release (SportParma, 2026-06-05, opened 2026-10-03) confirms the Crédit Agricole logo on the 2026/27 shirt.

source.name: Parma Calcio 1913, 'Parma Calcio scende in campo con Moby'
source.quote: a partire dalla stagione 2025/2026 sarà back sponsor di maglia della Prima Squadra Maschile
source.note: 'From the 2025/2026 season Moby will be back sponsor of the Men's First Team shirt' (Italian). Still on the 2026/27 shirt per the club's kit-launch press release (SportParma, 2026-06-05, opened 2026-10-03), which lists Moby's logo on the Men's First Team shirt.

summary: Puma kit. Prometeon main front sponsor, AdmiralBet.news second front sponsor, Crédit Agricole left sleeve, Moby back. All four confirmed on the 2026/27 men's shirt by the club's launch press release. No shorts sponsor.
